assessments.finding_note: “张郃、高览攻营失败，被郭图进谗，杀使者投降曹操”容易理解为张郃、高览共同杀死使者；原文明确是高览杀使者，张郃随后同意投降。
assessments.reason: The wording assigns the messenger's killing to both Zhang He and Gao Lan, whereas the original explicitly has Gao Lan kill the messenger and Zhang He subsequently agree to defect.
assessments.required_fix: 改为“张郃、高览攻营失败，被郭图进谗；高览杀死使者，张郃随后同意投降曹操。”

assessments.finding_note: “曹操粮尽，荀彧来信”略显绝对，原文是粮草逐渐匮乏、曹操考虑退兵后向荀彧求策。
assessments.reason: This is a slight compression and overstatement of the supply situation; the accepted scene preserves the main event and causal chain.
